entities.summary: The Adas Yereim synagogue is a former non-consistorial Orthodox Jewish synagogue, located at 10 Rue Cadet in the 9th arrondissement of Paris. It is also known as the Synagogue of the Rue Cadet or Strictly Observant Israeli Community.
